reviewBoundary: Second producer deep review of the uncommitted FableCut-informed Workbench V2, typed editor operations, Project Bin, rhythm evidence, MCP control plane and local distribution changes.

findings.problem: Typed commands accept undeclared top-level and operation-argument fields, weakening the advertised closed allowlist.
Apply can omit base SHA and undo/redo do not require the caller's current Timeline SHA, allowing a stale client to mutate current history.
Project Bin does not reject duplicate refs and exact asset replacement is routed through a bounded substring search.
A cached waveform can be returned after the source identity changes, while FFmpeg extraction does not revalidate the opened session source.
Dragging an overlay with position keyframes writes base x/y values that keyframe playback immediately overrides.
The 1 MB MCP line limit is checked only after readline has buffered the complete line.
MCP registration treats every get failure as absence and reports installed without mandatory client readback.
Rhythm evidence arrays are weakly validated and a derived plan can omit rhythm evidence carried by its approved analysis.
Snapshot recovery checks lexical containment but not the snapshot realpath.
A pending work-area in-point and asset selection survive opening a different Timeline.
Direct Timeline validation does not enforce the same bounded marker and delivery-frame strings as typed mutations.
Clip move and trim previews do not clean up transient DOM state when the browser emits pointercancel.

remediations.change: Closed every typed command shape and made current Timeline SHA mandatory for apply, undo and redo across schema, CLI, Studio and MCP.
Added unique Project Bin identity validation and exact-ref lookup; revalidated source identity before and after bounded waveform generation.
Made keyframed overlay drag an atomic x/y keyframe edit, reset cross-project transient state and cleaned move/trim previews on pointer cancellation.
Replaced whole-line MCP buffering with a bounded streaming parser and made registration preflight/readback fail closed.
Bound rhythm evidence into derivation, validated bounded technical arrays, resolved recovery snapshot realpaths and aligned direct Timeline metadata bounds.

verification.editorFocused: 6/6 pass after final pointer lifecycle fix
verification.mcp: pass including oversized-line recovery and stale-SHA rejection
verification.distribution: pass including fail-closed preflight and mandatory readback
verification.website: lint, typecheck, dual-language Pages package and dependency audit pass
verification.browser: desktop direct keyframe drag plus undo/redo pass; 390x844 no overflow; pointercancel removes transient transform without changing Timeline SHA; zero console errors or warnings
